ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Arthur Ashe Synthetic CCD — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

text.paragraph: Establishing primary care for HIV after a recent diagnosis with cerebral toxoplasmosis, and for coronary artery disease after two bypass operations. Concerns: He wants to decide for himself who learns of his HIV diagnosis, and when; He wants to keep coaching and playing tennis without putting his heart at risk. [S]

tr.td: Establishing primary care for HIV after a recent diagnosis with cerebral toxoplasmosis, and for coronary artery disease after two bypass operations
Four-week check of potassium and creatinine, second hepatitis B vaccine, and infectious diseases consultation
Six-month HIV and coronary disease review with depression screening
Nine-month HIV review: decision to stop toxoplasmosis maintenance therapy

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

tr.td: Antiretroviral therapy with bictegravir, emtricitabine, and tenofovir alafenamide once daily, chosen for its high barrier to resistance and few interactions with his cardiac medicines; viral load and CD4 count every three months
Infectious diseases consultation to co-manage HIV: the regimen and its interactions, opportunistic-infection prophylaxis, the monitoring schedule, and vaccines

Toxoplasma maintenance therapy with trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole double strength twice daily, which also prevents Pneumocystis pneumonia, until the CD4 count is above 200 for more than six months on suppressive therapy; blood count, potassium, and creatinine every three months while on it

Secondary prevention of coronary disease after two bypass operations: aspirin, high-intensity atorvastatin with ezetimibe added for an LDL goal below 55 mg/dL, blood pressure below 130/80, a heart-healthy diet, regular exercise, and a written chest-pain plan with sublingual nitroglycerin

Vaccines for adults with HIV: pneumococcal, hepatitis B with an antibody check afterwards, the two-dose meningococcal ACWY series, recombinant zoster, and seasonal influenza and COVID-19, with no live vaccines while the CD4 count is below 200

Person-first, confidential care: he decides who learns of his diagnosis; support with disclosure if and when he chooses, peer support, and depression screening with the PHQ-9 at intake and six months and the PHQ-2 at the preventive visit
HIV-1 viral load not detected by the three-month visit
Viral load not detected (below 20 copies/mL) at three months, and at six and nine months
CD4 count above 200 cells/uL for more than six months with an undetectable viral load, so that maintenance therapy can stop safely
CD4 218 at three months, 262 at six months, and 318 at nine months; trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole stopped
LDL cholesterol below 55 mg/dL by the three-month visit
LDL cholesterol 52 mg/dL on atorvastatin and ezetimibe
Hepatitis B vaccine series completed with a protective antibody level by the three-month visit
Blood pressure 116 to 120 over 72 to 74 at every visit

list.item: Right-hand weakness at diagnosis has recovered: grip and fine finger movements equal on both sides; writes and plays without difficulty [S]
Independent in all activities; vigorous exercise without angina or breathlessness [S]
Alert, composed, and thoughtful; asks precise questions about his treatment [S]
Mood mostly good, with worry about his family and his privacy; PHQ-9 score 5 with item 9 scored 0; no thoughts of self-harm [S]
